harnessCorrections: Reject explicit migration failure even when simctl returns exit 0.
Select standard smaller installed profiles; isolate device jobs and create fresh temporary simulators.
Record each bootstrap phase, native command, driver diagnostics and memory/process evidence.
Remove launchctl and desktop Safari session creation as mandatory iOS-readiness gates.
For future manual runs, request Simulator.app asynchronously while retaining completed bootstatus, MobileSafari launch and a real iOS session as mandatory checks.
evidenceLimits: None of these runs establish that Meridian Wake works or fails in native iOS/iPadOS Safari.
Desktop Safari and Playwright WebKit/mobile emulation evidence must be reported separately.
No physical-phone performance, multi-touch, long-press control or native mobile audio/save claim is supported by these attempts.
Future script success still requires trusted WebDriver input, application screenshots, first-mission travel and docking, audio activation, and same-session save reload.
Device identifiers, workstation paths and stack-trace paths have been removed from this durable record. Full raw CI artifacts may expire under the workflow retention policy.
